description: Pyrosage: flame intelligence (pyro = fire, sage = wise one). In microgravity, fire behaves nothing like it does on Earth: no buoyancy, spherical flames, unpredictable spread. We're using AI on NASA's microgravity combustion data to predict how fires grow and die out, helping keep astronauts safe. Physics-minded Houston team seeking teammates in ML, data analysis, statistics, and web development. No combustion background needed, just curiosity. Message us to join!
